dedupe_keys.name: indicateur gaz renouvelables aux horizons 2030 et 2035

description: Indicateur Gaz Renouvelables aux horizons 2030 et 2035 is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données restitue la dynamique de production de biométhane nationale par rapport à sa consommation de gaz (suivants 3 scénarios de consommation). Le calcul de ce ration s'appuie sur: la production de gaz à horizon 2030 et 2035 d'après les scenarii Perspectives Gaz disponibles sur ODRE. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Consommation, Production. Its keywords are IGR, Prospective. The portal shows 2025-03-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
